# Handcut

> Handcut is a captions-first iPhone video editor. It transcribes speech on-device into word-by-word captions and adds no watermark on any tier. No account, no ads. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762062166

## What it does
- Word-by-word (karaoke) captions timed from the audio; edit any word, restyle, reposition
- Burn captions into the video, or export an SRT file for Final Cut Pro and other editors
- Picture-in-picture: screen recording + facecam bubble + captions
- Multi-clip timeline, 18 film looks, 14 transitions, speed 0.25x-4x, text/emoji/images, music and voiceover mixer, keyframes, crop/reframe to vertical, square or widescreen, up to 60fps, 4K export

## Free vs Pro
- Free: 3 captioned exports per rolling week, unlimited uncaptioned exports, unlimited projects and length, 4K export, keyframes, picture-in-picture, no watermark
- Pro (monthly, annual or one-time lifetime): unlimited captioned exports, transcript editing (delete words to cut video), motion tracking, Smart Cutout, Auto-Reframe, denoise, Auto Match Look, version history, premium styles

## Good fit for
People who talk to camera: coaches, course creators, realtors, podcasters, product sellers. A CapCut alternative for captions without a watermark.

## Limits
- iPhone only (iOS 17+); no Android, web or desktop
- Caption languages depend on Apple on-device speech recognition; English is the primary supported language
